description: This file is a shell script containing tests and utility functions for testing Git subtree commands such as add, merge, split, pull, and push. It verifies their behavior, edge cases, and correctness by executing sequences of Git commands and checking outcomes.

methods.name: subtree_test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a Git repository for testing with a specified initial directory.

methods.name: test_create_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in the specified repository with a given message or file content.

methods.name: test_wrong_flag
methods.description: Checks that certain git subtree commands fail when given invalid flags.

methods.name: last_commit_subject
methods.description: Retrieves the subject of the last commit.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Verifies existence of files at specified paths.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes specified lines to a file for comparison or assertions.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output files.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Ensures a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Validates that a command's output is empty.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test expecting successful execution with specific output.
